answer: The network treats each answer as collateral: incoherent text on the anchor scores zero and the identity stops earning. Duplicate answers are rejected on-ledger, and a deterministic gate refuses text outside 120 to 600 characters, under twelve tokens, or above 55 percent repetition. Bulk filler fails automatically, removing the cheapest cipher a farm has: one phrase sent a thousand times. Net effect on the ocean: identity count stops being leverage, and the only way to scale is to produce genuinely more independent reasoning. Seal 1t8ey.
